component.name: Safeer Browser
component.summary: Sovereign, fast and private WebKit web browser

description.p: Safeer Browser is an open-source, sovereign, and lightweight web browser natively engineered with GTK3 and WebKit2GTK for Linux Mint (Cinnamon, MATE, XFCE) and Ubuntu. It provides bookmarks, configurable privacy settings and a desktop interface.

ul.li: YouTube playback and configurable ad filtering.
Local reverse domain trie threat shield blocking botnets, ransomware, and phishing (abuse.ch).
Instant 1-click bookmarks import directly from Firefox and Chrome profiles.
Onboarding wizard with DuckDuckGo default search and optional default browser setting.
Bookmarks toolbar and muscle-memory keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+T, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+K).
Encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) local loopback tunnel and strict 3rd-party cookie blocking.
Native Debian package (.deb) with safe alternatives priority (40) that never aggressively hijacks defaults.

screenshot.caption: Safeer Browser with Bookmarks Toolbar and DuckDuckGo on Linux Mint
Onboarding Setup Wizard and Privacy Settings

description.p: Hide empty ad inserts and "Please disable adblock or subscribe" placeholders on Push Square, Nintendo Life, Pure Xbox and Time Extension.
YouTube and YouTube Music keep playing without the "Video paused. Continue watching?" prompt.
Keep WebKit finalization on the GTK thread, prevent crash reload loops and defer restored background tabs.
Linux packaging and desktop appearance improvements.
Preserve Grok sign-in pages, use native WebKit identity, and retain YouTube playback configuration.
Reduce redundant YouTube page work and use the web browser resource cache.
Remove YouTube ad instructions before playback and recover safely from interrupted search connections.
Fix default browser registration and verification.
Preserve sign-in popups, forms and verification pages.
Fix startup with enabled sidebar integrations.
Fix encrypted DNS transport, concurrent connections, YouTube media stability and false malware warnings for advertising domains.

Release v1.0.7: Added onboarding setup wizard, bookmarks toolbar, DuckDuckGo default search engine, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+T, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+1..9, Ctrl+K), and safe alternatives priority (40).
Release v1.0.6: 1-click bookmarks import from Firefox and Chrome, session restore, Ctrl+F in-page search, Ctrl+P print to PDF, and DoH proxy.
